answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by requiring each identity to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before it can earn, like a river that only lets one boat pass per toll. A reputation bridge links that stake to real work history across services, so a new fake account starts with zero trust and must pay the full cost again. A public beacon publishes the stake and work record, letting anyone verify an identity cheaply while making a thousand fake identities a thousand times as expensive.
